description: Align the supervisor skill with the prd task artifacts: replace retired progress.txt and evidence.md references with prd.json and the PR body, and pass /ste on every changed prose file.

userStories.title: Replace retired artifact names in the supervisor skill
userStories.description: As a supervisor, I want /supervisor to name prd.json and the PR body as the advisor record so that no advisor writes the retired progress.txt.
acceptanceCriteria: `git grep -n -E 'progress\.txt|progress/evidence|evidence\.md|evidence artifact' -- .agro/skills/supervisor` prints nothing and exits 1.
Each replaced passage names `prd.json` (`passes`, `commit`, `notes`) or the PR body evidence sections as the advisor record.
The `description` and `allowed-tools` frontmatter lines are byte-identical to `origin/development`.
The description text has 1024 characters or fewer.

userStories.title: Replace retired artifact names in other control-plane surfaces
userStories.description: As an advisor, I want each .agro/ and docs/ surface to name only current task artifacts so that no procedure routes me to a retired file.
acceptanceCriteria: `bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh` exits 0 for each of the three edited files.

definitionOfDone: `git grep -n -I -E 'progress\.txt|evidence\.md|progress/evidence' -- .agro docs ':!.agro/tasks'` prints only the two kept lines, and the PR body lists each kept line with its reason.
The supervisor description has 1024 characters or fewer, and the `description` line is unchanged.

`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh <file>` exits 0 for prd.md and for each changed .md file; the advisor reviews each change by hand against the /ste rules the checker cannot catch; the PR body holds each command and its exit 0 output; the PR opens only after this criterion passes.
A PR from task/1402-supervisor-prd-align to development exists with each criterion's command output in its body. The PR is not merged.
openQuestions: Claude Code exposes Monitor and TaskStop, not MonitorCreate, MonitorList, or MonitorStop. Which tool names must /supervisor require? Blocked until supervisor direction.
